Reproducibility: not applicable. for the original feature request as a bug reproduction; the remaining docs finding is source-reproducible because the examples use July 8, 2026 while the CLI rejects past schedules.

target.title: feat: add scheduled messages
target.body:
## Summary
- add `send-rich --schedule <iso8601>` for bridge-backed Send Later text creation
- add read-only `scheduled list` and JSON-RPC `scheduledMessages.getScheduledMessages`
- expose scheduled text creation over JSON-RPC via `scheduledMessages.createScheduledMessage`
- add scheduled row schema detection, status selector reporting, docs, and tests
- fix scheduled create output to resolve the actual scheduled `chat.db` row GUID instead of returning the transient bridge GUID
- filter `scheduled list` to future scheduled rows so delivered Send Later rows do not linger in the pending list
- reject `send-rich --file --schedule` until scheduled attachments are proven
- remove the unproven scheduled cancel/delete CLI/RPC surface; cancel remains unsupported/fail-closed

## Redacted runtime proof on lobster
Proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/163-scheduled-messages`.
Short-delivery proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/163-scheduled-messages/short-delivery-20260708-194319`.
Scope-fix proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/163-scheduled-messages/scope-fix-20260708-204027`.
Review-fix proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/163-scheduled-messages/review-fix-20260708-204953`.
Raw logs stay local because they include chat/message GUIDs and local account identifiers.

Before on upstream `main`:
- `origin/main` did not expose `scheduled` command routing or `scheduledMessages.*` RPC methods.

After on branch `6d77ce9`:
- `imsg completions llm` exposes `send-rich --schedule` and `scheduled list`.
- `imsg completions llm` no longer exposes `scheduled cancel`.
- `imsg status --json` advertises only `scheduledMessages.createScheduledMessage` and `scheduledMessages.getScheduledMessages` for scheduled APIs; cancel/delete are absent.
- `send-rich --file /tmp/does-not-matter.jpg --schedule 2026-07-10T20:00:00Z` exits `1` before bridge dispatch with: `Invalid value for option: --schedule cannot be combined with file`.
- `send-rich --reply-to parent-guid --schedule 2026-07-10T20:00:00Z` exits `1` before bridge dispatch with: `Invalid value for option: --schedule cannot be combined with reply-to`.
- Scheduled row GUID resolution now filters by chat, scheduled time, and message text, and returns no row on ambiguity instead of taking the first match.

Create/list proof:
- Target was the explicit test chat `Lobster Test Group` (chat row 22); identifiers are redacted.
- `./bin/imsg send-rich --chat <redacted-chat-guid> --text 'PR163 scheduled proof fixed <stamp>' --schedule <+1h ISO8601> --json` returned `queued=1`, `scheduleType=2`, `scheduleState=1`, `scheduledAt=<+1h>`.
- `./bin/imsg scheduled list --json` returned the same scheduled row with `chat_id=22`, `schedule_type=2`, `schedule_state=1`, and the same scheduled timestamp.
- The fixed `send-rich --schedule --json` result resolves the real scheduled DB row GUID; redacted compare: `send_guid == list_guid`.

Delivery proof:
- Scheduled two short-window messages in `Lobster Test Group`:
  - `PR163 short delivery +1 20260708-194319`, due `2026-07-08 19:44:19 PDT`
  - `PR163 short delivery +3 20260708-194319`, due `2026-07-08 19:46:19 PDT`
- User visually confirmed both messages arrived in Messages.app.
- `imsg history --chat-id 22 --limit 10 --json` read both delivered rows back with `created_at` exactly matching their scheduled timestamps.
- After delivery, `scheduled list` no longer reports those delivered rows; it only reports future scheduled rows.

Cancel investigation / limitation:
- Manual native cancel of two future proof rows removed their `message` rows and `chat_message_join` rows entirely; no tombstone rows appeared in `deleted_messages` or `scheduled_messages_pending_cloudkit_delete`.
- Existing `delete-message` / `deleteChatItems:` was tested against a disposable scheduled row and did **not** cancel it; the message later delivered.
- `IMDMessageRecordDeleteMessagesForGUIDs` was tested against a disposable scheduled row and was also a false positive: it removed the DB row and `scheduled list` entry, but Messages.app still showed a dashed Send Later bubble and the message later delivered at its due time.
- Therefore cancel/delete are not exposed in this PR. The current scope is scheduled text create/list/delivery only.

## Verification
- `make build` ✅ on lobster for `6d77ce9`
- `swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests TestsLinux` ✅ as the first phase of `make lint`; verified again after the 600-line file-length fix
- `make lint` ⚠️ blocked after swift-format by local SwiftLint/SourceKit crash: `Loading sourcekitdInProc.framework/Versions/A/sourcekitdInProc failed`
- `make test` ⚠️ blocked before tests execute on this host: SwiftPM cannot import repo-wide `Testing` module (`no such module 'Testing'`)
- GitHub CI ✅ for `6d77ce9`; previous head `03b80b1` had a macOS test compile failure in the scheduled stdout assertion, fixed by destructuring `StdoutCapture.capture` output correctly
